geography: Worldwide (Eisai-recorded; Japan, China and Asia / Asia and Latin America itemised)

approval_evidence.quote: ARICEPT® (donepezil hydrochloride) tablets, for oral use | Initial U.S. Approval: 1996 | ARICEPT is an acetylcholinesterase inhibitor indicated for the treatment of dementia of the Alzheimer's type

series_start_reason: Earliest quarter delivered is Eisai FY2013 Q1 (Apr-Jun 2013, calendar 2013Q2): the first column of the 'Changes in Quarterly Revenue from Major Products' Aricept table in Eisai's FY2014 full-year Reference Data (TDnet 2015-05-11), the oldest Eisai Reference Data located that prints the table; it prints FY2013 and FY2014 on the IFRS basis Eisai adopted from FY2014. Eisai's FY2013 and earlier Reference Data were issued under Japanese GAAP and could not be located: eisai.com/ir/* answers HTTP 302 to the home page, the JPX archive begins with the filing of 2017-01-05, and no TDnet mirror located holds them. Eisai's own releases of 2007-2008 (sec.gov/Archives/edgar/vprr/0702/07025769.pdf, vprr/0800/08004219.pdf) print Aricept net sales in prose (Japanese GAAP) but no continuous run reaches 2013. Aricept was approved in the U.S. in 1996, so the series does not start at launch.
series_end_reason: Eisai's Reference Data filed 2026-07-31 (FY2026 Q1, Apr-Jun 2026; https://www2.jpx.co.jp/disc/45230/140120260731505609.pdf) replaces the neurology table with 'Major Products (3L)' (Lenvima, Leqembi, Dayvigo) in 'Changes in Quarterly Revenue from Major Products' and prints no Aricept total row; Aricept appears only as separate Japan and EAGS lines in the regional product tables. The last total is FY2025 Q4 (Jan-Mar 2026), calendar 2026Q1 (filed 2026-05-14).
notes: Eisai prints one global 'Aricept' row with regional sub-rows. The total is larger than the printed sub-rows (FY2015 Q1: 18.0 against Japan 11.4 + China 1.4 + Asia 2.6 = 15.4), so the total includes revenue not itemised by region; the total row is used as printed. The printed label reads 'Aricept (Alzheimer's disease / Dementia with Lewy bodies treatment)' until the filing of 2024-05-15 and 'Aricept (Alzheimer's disease treatment)' from the filing of 2024-08-02; every quarter is identical in every document that prints it (44 quarters, checked across all 21 documents). Values are Eisai's consolidated revenue in JPY billions to one decimal, so each is precise only to JPY 0.1 billion. Fiscal April-March quarters mapped to calendar quarters (FY Q1 Apr-Jun = calendar Q2). 2013Q2 to 2015Q1 are read from the FY2014 full-year Reference Data (TDnet 2015-05-11), where all eight quarters FY2013 Q1 to FY2014 Q4 are printed on the IFRS basis; the quarter's own earlier documents were not located, so only FY2014 Q4 is a current-column read.
